posts.script: Fishtank put a New York clothing store under 24/7 surveillance. On September 13th, the project ‘As Seen On’ began broadcasting employees and customers on Canal Street. Every visitor must sign a legal waiver before entering. Viewers can now interact with staff using live text-to-speech messages. posts.title: Summit1g Wardogs Ban Controversy Timeline
posts.script: Summit1g was permanently banned from Wardogs mid-stream September 12th. The notification appeared live. CEO Joe Brammer later confirmed the ban was caused by human error. A developer trying to ban a suspected cheater in the match accidentally targeted Summit1g’s account. The ban was reversed, but developer Bulkhead was suspended for throwing a dildo at a colleague on stream. Is this studio too chaotic to manage a game?

posts.title: Tatu Suspended From CBLOL Playoffs After Stepz Clash
posts.script: R$15,000 and a playoff suspension for Tatu. On September 6, the FURIA jungler walked across the stage to confront RED Canids' Stepz face-to-face during the CBLOL Playoffs. But Riot Games didn't just fine him—they banned Tatu for the Upper Bracket semi-finals against LOS, forcing FURIA to scramble for an emergency substitute. With casters calling the ruling "overkill," was a playoff suspension too harsh for stage trash talk?
